text: Electronic science and technology is a fundamental discipline in the field of information technology. Its core lies in studying "the movement laws of electrons" and "how to utilize these laws to manufacture materials, devices and systems with specific functions". From the chips in mobile phones to the CT equipment in hospitals, from optical fiber communication to satellite navigation, the underlying technologies of almost all electronic information products originate from this discipline. It serves as a bridge connecting "physical theories" and "engineering applications", requiring exploration of the microscopic behaviors of electrons and photons, as well as solving problems related to the design, manufacturing and application of actual devices. It is a "cornerstone discipline" that supports the modern information society.
